SELECT `merchant_accounts`.* FROM `merchant_accounts` WHERE `merchant_accounts`.`user_id` = 1 AND `merchant_accounts`.`deleted_at` IS NULL AND `merchant_accounts`.`charge_processor_alive_at` IS NOT NULL AND `merchant_accounts`.`charge_processor_deleted_at` IS NULL AND `merchant_accounts`.`charge_processor_id` = 'stripe'
SELECT `purchases`.* FROM `purchases` WHERE `purchases`.`subscription_id` = 1 AND ((`purchases`.`flags` & 4 = 4)) AND ((`purchases`.`flags` & 131072 = 0)) LIMIT 1
SELECT `orders`.* FROM `orders` INNER JOIN `order_purchases` ON `orders`.`id` = `order_purchases`.`order_id` WHERE `order_purchases`.`purchase_id` = 100 LIMIT 1
